verdict.rationale: The evidence only covers minting and redeeming Paxos's own stablecoins (USDG, PYUSD, USDP), such as USD-to-stablecoin and stablecoin-to-USD orchestrations, plus monthly reserve reports for USDG. These are adjacent features of Paxos-issued assets, not a documented product for a founder to issue their own branded stablecoin. Nothing in the pack describes white-label issuance, issuer-side reserve management, or how access to such a product is gated.
